top_signals.title: European Stocks Fall as US Chip Curbs Ignite Fresh AI Selloff
top_signals.summary: European stocks opened lower as concerns over the artificial-intelligence trade swept markets ahead of Nvidia Corp.’s results, after the US moved to impose sweeping new restrictions on China’s access to high-end AI chips.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Tech Stock Selloff Eases in Countdown to Nvidia  Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Selling pressure on US technology stocks eased ahead of Nvidia Corp.’s much-anticipated results that could prove as pivotal for the company as for the broader artificial-intelligence trade.

top_signals.title: Australia to Investigate China Over Alleged Timber Dumping
top_signals.summary: The Australian government will investigate allegations that China exported structural timber products at “less than their normal value,” potentially undercutting local firms in the middle of a national housing crisis.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Turkish stocks are set to rebound after a fund crisis pushed the index into oversold territory, according to analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co., who upgraded the country’s market to overweight from neutral.

top_signals.title: World-time watch pioneer VOGARD returns with ENCORE, unveiled at London Watch Week
top_signals.summary: Twenty years after introducing one of Switzerland’s most ingenious travel-watch innovations, VOGARD returns with ENCORE – a rare opportunity to own an original created with the inventor himself.
